title: Configuring Business Central Server for outdated versions

facts.text: Page applies to version 20 (2022 release wave 1) and earlier, which are no longer supported.
Server configuration is stored in a CustomSettings.config file located at [installation path]\Service by default.
Each server instance has its own CustomSettings.config file.
Configure the server during setup by selecting Demo, Server, Developer option or customizing the Customize Server component.
Modify settings after installation using the admin tool, Set-NAVServerConfiguration PowerShell cmdlet, or by directly editing CustomSettings.config with a text editor.
Some settings are dynamically updatable, meaning the server does not require restart after modification through the PowerShell cmdlet.
Direct editing of CustomSettings.config is not recommended because typing errors may prevent the server instance from starting.
Management services provide PowerShell commands like Invoke-NAVCodeunit with configurable idle timeout and TCP port.
